purpose: read-only sources consumed by the path_dependent_cost run; this tree writes none of them
reconstruction_policy: none. The Python side CONSUMES the pinned sealed modules as libraries through the repository's own import path. The one two-line state functional it shares with two unmerged sibling trees is restated rather than imported, because an open pull request is not an ancestor of HEAD and stacking is prohibited; the restatement is declared here rather than left for a reader to find. The Lean side states everything over an abstract state, an abstract one-item action and an abstract functional, so it reconstructs nothing at all -- including the one result it borrows from an unmerged sibling, which is re-proved here rather than cited across an open branch.

spans.role: datum admission absorbs a repeat; form admission appends unconditionally -- the two clauses the monotonicity and the self-loop classification rest on
instance and rule admission: set union, so a repeat changes nothing
iter_cost1_items: the estate's own one-item move set, which is the edge set of the move graph
